results.title: Leaving Fangoria
results.overview: Canadian horror film critic, Chris Alexander, explores his career leading up to his time as editor-in-chief at the iconic magazine, "Fangoria".

results.title: Radio Destino
results.overview: On a typical night, two friends drive home after a party. The radio searches for a signal while interference mixes with their voices. Between flashes of streetlights and tired laughter, Sara and Violeta talk about love, desire, and disappointment.

results.title: Operation Kabul
results.overview: A Hungarian doctor's story intertwines with soldiers' sacrificial fight and desperate refugees' escape from a war-torn city.

results.title: A Love Like No Other
results.overview: 29 year old Lasse has almost broken the connection with his family. After a tragic accident he is suddenly left with the responsibility for his much younger brother, Vincent.

results.title: Papa Zola: The Movie
results.overview: Papa Zola and his gifted daughter Pipi embark on everyday adventures that highlight their close bond and her quick wit.

results.title: Watch the Skies
results.overview: When a small starship crashes to earth, it is not a monster or alien overlord that emerges, but a teenage boy who has run away from home - a home on the far side of the galaxy. He is rescued from capture by the children of the same military leaders who are trying to catch him. Together, the kids must help their new alien friend repair his space ship from parts left behind by other alien explorers and escape before he is caught by the soldiers and studied by the scientists for the rest of his life.

results.title: Bamboolak
results.overview: Bamboolak, the last grandson of Bambala Khan, is on a mission to help Nana achieve her dream of having a sibling, but Shatunak does not want them to achieve their dream.

results.title: Night Shoot
results.overview: A college documentary project goes awry when a group of film students stumble on a strange, wooded homeless community, and slowly discover they’re the ones being watched.

results.title: Sea Lions of the Galapagos
results.overview: Follow Leo, a handsome sea lion pup who's learning how to navigate life alongside his mother, Luna.

results.title: Pet Shop Days
results.overview: On the run from his unforgiving father in Mexico, Alejandro finds himself in New York City, where he meets Jack, a pet store employee with similar parental baggage. Together the two enter a whirlwind romance sending them down the rabbit hole of drugs and depravity in Manhattan’s underworld. When Alejandro’s past threatens to catch up with him, Jack is forced to choose between his family and a life on the run.

results.title: Apathy 2
results.overview: The main character of the film, Akif, escapes from an orphanage to find his mother. On this painful journey, with an uncertain ending, the protagonist faces numerous challenges. The swift intervention of a prosecutor’s office employee raises many questions for the audience about the essence of life. Apathy-2 delivers a powerful "slap" to the mentality of bringing children into this world thoughtlessly.

results.title: Eloy de la Iglesia: Film Addict
results.original_title: Eloy de la Iglesia, adicto al cine
results.overview: A dauntless film director, an enfant terrible in his early days, confrontational with censorship, always pushing the boundaries of freedom of expression, chronicler of the darkest corners of the transition, De la Iglesia will fall into the clutches of drug addiction, being forgotten and sometimes repudiated for more than a decade before eventually shaking off the ostracism to make films once again, that habit he could never kick.

results.title: Kamen Rider Majade with Girls Remix
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーマジェード withガールズリミックス
results.overview: Rinne Kudo, who is studying abroad in England, sees her classmate kidnapped by Yoko Minato right in front of her. Rinne returns to Japan with Sophia's guidance, who is investigating a series of female kidnappings, and decides to investigate the case with Girls Remix. They head to the scene of the crime with Reika Shindai to investigate a case suspected to involve an alchemist. At that moment, Yoko appears again and attacks them, but a woman who looks like Clotho appears and fights Yoko. Will Rinne be able to solve the case and save her classmates?!

results.title: An Endless Wedding
results.overview: During a wedding in a riad on the edge of the Moroccan desert, Paul meets Louna, the bride's sister and witness. Following a paranormal event, they both find themselves trapped in the same space-time, forced to live the same day over and over again. And so begins a love story set against the backdrop of a time loop and a never-ending marriage…

results.title: Darwin
results.overview: A group of thieves, that prey on the affluent millennial society, gets more than they bargained for, when they encounter an adversary more formidable than they could've imagined.

results.title: Cuando el viento
results.overview: Ana wants to go hunting but her older sister and her grandfather do not allow her. Ana is haunted by her nightmares but what is more troubling are the secrets lurking home.

results.title: Ozora: Penganiayaan Brutal Penguasa Jaksel
results.overview: When his son falls into a coma after a brutal assault by the son of a powerful official, a father fights a corrupt legal system alongside loyal allies and a united nation praying for a miracle to secure justice for the boy.

results.title: Rewound Up
results.overview: Set in 2006, a directionless young man Mark, finds himself trapped working in a dying video store. His apathy towards cinema is challanged when faith brings John into his store. While not his original intention John brings a new found passion for cinema out in Mark.
